meaning: to want, to ask for something

english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice when asking for an item or service.

exampleSentences.english: I’d like to request a cup of iced lemon tea.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 jiu3 jat1 bui1 dung3 ling4 caa4

english.note: Use 要 when asking for an item or service, or when something is required or demanded, rather than when asking someone to perform an action.

exampleSentences.english: I want to ask for a glass of iced lemon tea.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 jiu3 jat1 bui1 dung3 ling4 caa4
